representations.name: Kummer carry-free digit automata
representations.new_information: For each prime p, accepts exactly the integers whose base-p digits all lie in {0,...,(p-1)/2}.
representations.repairs_loss: Retains every digit restriction instead of replacing the exceptional-prime set by all primes.
representations.first_test: Replay against exact binomial valuations for dense n and every p<=n.
representations.closure_interface: Needs a pointwise bound on the reciprocal mass of automata simultaneously accepting one n.

representations.name: Nested lower-half prime-power residues
representations.new_information: Encodes carry freedom as n mod p^j < p^j/2 for every relevant j, making the nesting across powers explicit.
representations.repairs_loss: Prevents paying independently for the same prime at all of its powers.
representations.first_test: Search for the first p,j at which proposed single-level surrogates disagree with the full predicate.
representations.closure_interface: A unique-scale certificate must imply all nested conditions with summable loss.

representations.name: Legendre floor-jump ledger
representations.new_information: Writes v_p binomial(2n,n) as a sum of binary floor jumps indexed by p^j.
representations.repairs_loss: Identifies the exact scale at which divisibility first appears and keeps endpoint conventions exact.
representations.first_test: Cross-check the jump sum, digit predicate and direct integer binomial values on boundary-rich n.
representations.closure_interface: A proof may charge a nondividing prime to a missing jump, but only once.

representations.name: Fixed-quotient prime intervals
representations.new_information: For p^2>2n, partitions carry-free primes by q=floor(n/p) into exact intervals (n/(q+1/2),n/q].
representations.repairs_loss: Uses arithmetic interval length rather than the full Mertens mass of a large-prime band.
representations.first_test: Compare exact interval membership to digit tests and measure endpoint/short-interval errors.
representations.closure_interface: Must generalise recursively to prime powers without invoking unavailable uniform short-interval PNT.

representations.name: Critical prime-power annuli
representations.new_information: Assigns to p a distinguished power p^j near a chosen n-scale and records the lower and upper base-p blocks of n.
representations.repairs_loss: Offers one scale per prime and exposes how reciprocal prime mass distributes over exponent depths.
representations.first_test: Try sqrt(n), dyadic-log and adaptive annuli; reject any assignment whose scale charge grows on record n.
representations.closure_interface: Needs an O(1) total charge after summing all exponent depths.

representations.name: Recursive digit-block decomposition
representations.new_information: Splits n=a p^j+b with both blocks carry-free in base p and tracks contraction of the block sizes.
representations.repairs_loss: Retains the self-similar content behind the nested residues instead of treating levels as separate events.
representations.first_test: Measure whether candidate recurrences contract uniformly for primes near every power threshold.
representations.closure_interface: A recurrence must decrease n by a fixed scale while charging each prime only once.

representations.name: Adversarial CRT acceptance boxes
representations.new_information: For a finite prime set, represents simultaneous carry freedom below a cutoff as a product of allowed residue boxes modulo their prime powers.
representations.repairs_loss: Shows exactly how far different bases really are independent at a fixed finite scale.
representations.first_test: Optimise n modulo the product to maximise reciprocal accepted-prime weight and test naive density products.
representations.closure_interface: Any incompatibility theorem must beat exact CRT constructions using the global bound n.

representations.name: Fourier spectrum of lower-half residue sets
representations.new_information: Expands prime-power lower-half indicators into additive characters so simultaneous acceptance becomes a structured correlation sum.
representations.repairs_loss: Makes cross-prime correlations and boundary frequencies visible beyond pairwise independence heuristics.
representations.first_test: Compute low-modulus spectra and kill bounds whose nonzero-frequency contribution exceeds the claimed saving.
representations.closure_interface: Requires a pointwise correlation bound strong enough after summing reciprocal prime weights.

representations.name: Reciprocal-prime measure and stopping time
representations.new_information: Samples a prime with mass proportional to 1/p and stops at its first relevant digit or scale obstruction.
representations.repairs_loss: Matches the public objective directly and converts unique scale assignment into a probability statement.
representations.first_test: Compute stopping-level distributions for record n and for CRT-designed adversaries.
representations.closure_interface: A uniform positive obstruction probability at every unresolved mass level would close the bound.

representations.name: Mixed-base digit entropy
representations.new_information: Treats the same integer n as a codeword in many prime bases and records the entropy debt of keeping every digit in a half alphabet.
representations.repairs_loss: Targets the missing pointwise incompatibility between simultaneous carry-free descriptions.
representations.first_test: Compare entropy claims with exact CRT boxes, primorial-adjacent n and record holders of f(n).
representations.closure_interface: Must turn code-length conflict into a reciprocal-prime bound without averaging over n.
